integrity: Analytic proof supplies every infinite/domain-wide step; standalone symbolic and numerical tests are supplementary. p=1 recovers a previously published case and is not claimed as original. Historical priority is provisional, with an inaccessible older dissertation explicitly noted.
limitations: The theorem addresses two nonadaptive exact function values, independent common Bernoulli delivery and known stationary exponential covariance; no statements on additive noise, heterogeneous reliability, adaptive or higher-point designs. Independent validation remains unperformed.
title: Unique erasure-robust two-node quadrature for exponential Gaussian processes
